documents.title: Oracle listener recovery
documents.text: ORA-12541 TNS:no listener indicates that the database listener is unavailable. Verify lsnrctl status before restarting it.

documents.title: Nginx upstream saturation
documents.text: When reverse proxy requests intermittently fail, inspect upstream connection capacity, error logs, and backend health before changing limits.

documents.title: Cron service unavailable
documents.text: If scheduled jobs stop running, inspect the cron service state and journal, then verify a new scheduled execution.

documents.title: Filesystem pressure
documents.text: ENOSPC means the filesystem or inode table is full. Identify the largest safe cleanup candidates and verify free space after remediation.

documents.title: Host seven private procedure
documents.text: HOST7-ONLY identifies the private recovery procedure for host seven.
